import HartshorneLib.Chapter4P1Topology
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4RationalPartialFractions
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4DivisorSheafZero
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4CanonicalDifferentials

/-!
# Polynomial coordinates on the function field of `P1`

The polynomial algebra is induced by the actual affine-chart section map to
the generic stalk. Its fraction-field property transports partial fractions
to rational functions on the projective line.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry Polynomial

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.P1

noncomputable section

variable (k : Type u) [Field k]

/-- The two polynomial charts make the projective line an integral scheme. -/
instance : IsIntegral (P1 k) := by
  letI : IsReduced (P1 k) := by
    apply +allowSynthFailures isReduced_of_isReduced_stalk
    intro x
    have hchart (i : Fin 2) (hx : x ∈ chartOpen k i) :
        _root_.IsReduced ((P1 k).presheaf.stalk x) := by
      letI : IsDomain (HomogeneousLocalization.Away
          (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) (MvPolynomial.X i)) := by
        fin_cases i
        · exact MulEquiv.isDomain (Polynomial k)
            (awayAlgEquiv k fin_zero_ne_one).toRingEquiv.toMulEquiv
        · exact MulEquiv.isDomain (Polynomial k)
            (awayAlgEquiv k fin_one_ne_zero).toRingEquiv.toMulEquiv
      rw [← opensRange_chartι] at hx
      obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hx
      exact isReduced_of_injective ((chartι k i).stalkMap y).hom
        (asIso ((chartι k i).stalkMap y)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.injective
    have hx : x ∈ chartOpen k 0 ⊔ chartOpen k 1 := by
      rw [chartOpen_sup]
      trivial
    exact hx.elim (hchart 0) (hchart 1)
  exact isIntegral_of_irreducibleSpace_of_isReduced (P1 k)

instance : IsIntegral (asOver k).left := inferInstanceAs (IsIntegral (P1 k))

private theorem nonempty_chartOpen_zero : Nonempty (chartOpen k 0) := by
  obtain ⟨x⟩ : Nonempty (Spec (CommRingCat.of
    (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k)
      (MvPolynomial.X (0 : Fin 2))))) := inferInstance
  exact ⟨⟨(chartι k 0) x, by
    rw [← opensRange_chartι]
    exact ⟨x, rfl⟩⟩⟩

/-- Send a polynomial in the first chart coordinate to its generic germ. -/
def functionFieldPolynomialMap : k[X] →+* (P1 k).functionField := by
  letI := nonempty_chartOpen_zero k
  exact ((P1 k).germToFunctionField (chartOpen k 0)).hom.comp
    (chartSectionsEquiv₀ k).symm.toRingHom

/-- The coordinate algebra on the genuine generic stalk of `P1`. -/
abbrev functionFieldPolynomialAlgebra : Algebra k[X] (P1 k).functionField :=
  (functionFieldPolynomialMap k).toAlgebra

attribute [local instance] functionFieldPolynomialAlgebra

/-- The generic stalk is the fraction field of the standard polynomial chart. -/
theorem functionFieldPolynomial_isFractionRing :
    IsFractionRing k[X] (P1 k).functionField := by
  letI := nonempty_chartOpen_zero k
  letI := functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen (P1 k)
    (chartOpen k 0) (isAffineOpen_chartOpen k 0)
  exact IsFractionRing.of_ringEquiv_left (chartSectionsEquiv₀ k).symm (fun _ => rfl)

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Constants in the polynomial chart agree with the structure-morphism
scalars on the generic stalk. -/
theorem functionFieldPolynomialMap_C (r : k) :
    functionFieldPolynomialMap k (C r) =
      Hartshorne.functionFieldOverAlgebraMap k (asOver k).left r := by
  letI := nonempty_chartOpen_zero k
  have hscalar : (chartSectionsEquiv₀ k).symm (C r) =
      (asOver k).left.overAlgebraMap k (chartOpen k 0) r := by
    have h := structureMap_appTop_awayToSection k (X_mem k 0) one_pos
    have h' := congrArg (fun f => (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv ≫ f) h
    simp only [Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc] at h'
    have h'' := congrArg (fun f => f.hom r) h'
    change (asOver k).left.overAlgebraMap k (chartOpen k 0) r =
      (Proj.awayToSection (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k)
        (MvPolynomial.X 0)).hom (algebraMap k _ r) at h''
    apply (chartSectionsEquiv₀ k).injective
    rw [RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply, h'', chartSectionsEquiv₀_awayToSection]
    exact (awayAlgEquiv k fin_zero_ne_one).commutes r |>.symm
  change ((P1 k).germToFunctionField (chartOpen k 0)).hom
    ((chartSectionsEquiv₀ k).symm (C r)) = _
  rw [hscalar]
  exact Hartshorne.germ_generic_overAlgebraMap (X := asOver k) _ r

attribute [local instance] Hartshorne.functionFieldOverAlgebra

/-- The polynomial generic-germ map respects the ground-field algebra induced
by the structure morphism of the projective line. -/
def functionFieldPolynomialAlgHom : k[X] →ₐ[k] (asOver k).left.functionField where
  toRingHom := functionFieldPolynomialMap k
  commutes' := functionFieldPolynomialMap_C k

/-- Every genuine rational function on `P1` admits partial fractions in its
standard affine coordinate. -/
theorem exists_functionField_partialFractions [IsAlgClosed k]
    (f : (P1 k).functionField) :
    ∃ (q : k[X]) (s : Finset k) (n : k → ℕ) (c : (a : k) → Fin (n a) → k),
      f = functionFieldPolynomialMap k q + ∑ a ∈ s, ∑ j : Fin (n a),
        functionFieldPolynomialMap k (C (c a j)) *
          (functionFieldPolynomialMap k (X - C a))⁻¹ ^ (j.val + 1) := by
  letI := functionFieldPolynomial_isFractionRing k
  exact Hartshorne.RationalPartialFractions.exists_eq_polynomial_add_sum_inv_pow f

end
end AlgebraicGeometry.P1
